title: ConfigurationPropertyContribution
description: A code-side declaration that consumes a configuration value (e.g. Spring `@Value`/`@ConfigurationProperties`, FastAPI `Settings`, NestJS `ConfigService.get`, Micronaut `@Value`). Distinct from `Repository.ConfigEntry`, which captures the value as found in a config file: this slot captures the code's declared CONSUMPTION intent. Pattern-C universal slot (§8bis Rule 2). Producers (Rule 1): `SpringScanKS` today; future `MicronautScanKS`, `FastApiScanKS`, `NestJsScanKS`, etc.

consumerSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the field / parameter / function that consumes the configuration value. Pattern-C back-pointer (§8bis Rule 2).

key.description: Configuration key as referenced by the code (e.g. 'app.feature.x', 'DATABASE_URL').

defaultValue.description: Inline default if declared at the consumption site.

nativeAttributes.description: Pattern-C escape hatch (§8bis Rule 2). Framework-specific facts (e.g. Spring SpEL expression, `@ConfigurationProperties` prefix nesting, FastAPI `Field` validators).
